entry_points.text: Chip wiring exposes edge ack, affinity, message compose, forced move and retrigger under one ID; alternate build omits affinity and forced completion.
Diagnostics honor quiet, dump legacy, local APICs for configured count, then I/O APICs. Boot option selects all by keyword or prefix by number, default single.
Cluster probe runs only when clustered, sizing table for cache/CPUs. Physical forced by parameter or firmware plus flag, gating compat, probing when forced, required or selected.
Block size accepts override with order installer, halving for alignment above minimum, falling back to safe order on bad input.
Hook counts hub online for APs. VGA forwards decode only for I/O-enabled bridge events. Controller offers probe, fanout, secondary start, access and ack with native self.

exports.text: Edge ack finishes move then acks. Retrigger resends stored vector to stored target under lock, always succeeding.
Cleanup runs only while flagged, freeing old later. Offline under lock refuses with no-space when spare short, warning when reserved exceeds spare.

Secure backend offers probe, setup/teardown, signalling, write, EOI, ICR and update. Probe needs capability, mode and page; setup enables, teardown disables. Empty EOI warns; unknown errors; allowed 112 bytes every 16th after 4.
UV offers OEM check, system/hubless getters, presence/hubbed predicates, arch formatter, undefined handler and range predicate.

hazards.text: Undefined hub registers panic or log critically per suppress flag and return all-ones to fault.

invariants.text: Forced completion idles without data, previous vector or ownership. It frees moved vector, warns in stop-machine, notes stale and race risks.
Diagnostics report identity, version, priorities, logical/destination, spurious, bitmaps, error with erratum fix, command, timer and extended features.
Cluster follows high bits; logical holds cluster plus low-nibble bit. Mask copies, drops caller optionally, sends one per cluster then removes it, fencing with interrupts preserved.
Physical targets each CPU by stored ID, skips caller for all-but-self, uses shorthand for all, direct self, identity translation, fencing with interrupts preserved.

ICR maps self local, all with/without self, directed to target with forward/retain; NMI flags, fixed pends. Directed resolves IDs, mask walks with skip, broadcasts zero dest, self bypasses; fanout disables interrupts.
Reads serve timer/vectors via channel, identity/control/error locally, service/trigger on wide align, request/allowed on strides, else zero with warn on misalign, error on unknown.
Identity prefers firmware else vendor string trimmed. Prefixes select hubbed/hubless else non-UV; generations map to revisions, disabled NUMA aborts, then mode, node, socket, time and hooks derive.
Node/socket derives from early map and hub registers with tweaks and fallback, warning when map missing. BIOS time selects async, tolerant or unstable; APIC mode follows extended enablement.
Single uses NMI or fixed to node from stored ID. Groups reuse single across mask or online with exclusion. Secondary sends init then startup with vector from start address.
Low remap yields first alias as pow2 else zero. High windows derive span, skip null, report interval. Redirect checks bounds, groups runs, legacy direct; low regs map when nonzero; RTC falls back.

Geometry uses width, family rules, complement shift. Hub fills masks, shifts, tables, remap. Params retained; ranges log intervals/min/max; blade widens when nonempty; consolidation validates, merges, chains, shrinks, warns once, skips oversize.

locks.text: Deferred cleanup runs under global vector lock.
Legacy diagnostics hold legacy lock across port reads and writes.

state_machines.text: Masks allocate one per cluster sharing with siblings, reuse surviving for hotplug else allocate/prefill, mark present at init, clear and free at death.
Windows prefer newer overlay else legacy, skip with diagnostic when unavailable/disabled, else map with family caching, recording accelerator range.
Decode returns for oldest, disables with invalid argument when missing/outdated, else dispatches param/range by type, ignoring arch type, skipping unknown with diagnostic.

structs.text: Cluster keeps CPU to logical-ID table, per-CPU scratch masks and shared cluster membership pointers.
Cluster uses logical mode, physical uses physical mode, both with offline NMI, respective probe/delivery over MSR with native EOI and command.
Secure state is per-CPU page bytes with bitmap access and per-vector set/clear. Allowed base 516, NMI request 632.
Discovery holds shifts/masks, counts, system type, hub sets, graphics bounds, hub/node IDs, revision, strings and node-zero record.

Records, hub list, min/max, tables, maps, blades, clock and socket fields cover topology. Empty socket all-ones 16-bit; block 2GiB halved, order ffs else 31; alias 3; MMIOH legacy neg, newer paired parity; controller physical, no ext, ID max.
